source.label: Gottlieb Roller Coaster factory feature flyer

strategy.overview: Completing 1-2-3-4 through any matching numbered target or rollover upgrades the rotating pointer's 50 sector to 500. The three pointer-value rollovers and both kick-out holes cash the value it indicates; collecting that upgraded value resets the numbered sequence. Each kick-out sends the ball quickly along a wire rail toward a flipper.
strategy.simpleOverview: Complete 1-2-3-4 at whichever matching numbered targets or rollovers are safely available. That changes the pointer's 50 sector to 500. Then cash the upgraded pointer through the center lane or a kick-out hole whose fast wire-rail return you have already tested. Take ordinary pointer values when they arrive safely, but never aim for an outlane just because it also scores the pointer.
strategy.summary: Complete 1-2-3-4 to upgrade the pointer's 50 sector to 500, then collect it through a controlled center-lane or proven kick-out-hole feed and prepare for the fast rail return.

quickInfo.summary: Each number can be completed at a matching numbered target or rollover.

quickInfo.name: Pointer upgrade
quickInfo.summary: Completing all four numbers changes the pointer's 50 sector to 500 until that upgraded value is scored.

quickInfo.name: Pointer cash
quickInfo.summary: The center lane, both kick-out holes, and both outlanes score the current pointer value.

quickInfo.name: Wire-rail return
quickInfo.summary: Either kick-out sends the ball rapidly along a guide rail toward a flipper.

steps.text: Complete 1-2-3-4 through the safest available matching numbered targets and rollovers.
Before the set is complete, accept pointer-value scores that arrive naturally instead of forcing a dangerous ordinary-value cash.
After 1-2-3-4 is complete, wait for the pointer to indicate the upgraded 500 sector.
Collect that 500 through the center lane or a kick-out hole whose approach and return are controlled; the numbered sequence then resets.
After a kick-out, expect the wire rail to return the ball quickly and decide whether to hold or flip only after testing that copy.

buildsToward.title: A completed number set and upgraded pointer cash

steps.text: Finish the missing 1-2-3-4 numbers through safe matching targets or rollovers.
Let the completed set upgrade the pointer's 50 sector to 500.
Cash the upgraded value through a controlled center lane or proven kick-out-hole feed, then rebuild after the reset.

cautions.issue: Both outlanes score the pointer value, but choosing an outlane sacrifices the ball.
cautions.response: Use the center lane or a proven kick-out-hole approach for a planned cash; take outlane value only as drain compensation.

cautions.issue: The kick-out holes return the ball deceptively quickly along the wire rails.
cautions.response: Test each return before relying on a hold; be ready for an immediate flip if that copy does not settle the ball.

cautions.issue: A missing number can become expensive when repeated attempts rebound toward the center drain.
cautions.response: Stop forcing that number after a dangerous rebound and return to opportunistic pointer cashes until a safer feed appears.

machineSetup: Confirm Gottlieb Roller Coaster model 296, OPDB exact variant G42pZ-ML171, the June 1971 two-player EM. Do not transfer this guide to the 1973 Maresa derivative G42pZ-Mp4PZ; its rules and playfield parity are unverified.
Check ball count, replay or credit handling, tilt response, pointer indexing, and whether the installed event rules alter any replay award.

Test every numbered target and rollover, the pointer and 50-to-500 upgrade, all five pointer-value switches, both kick-out coils, wire-rail alignment, flipper strength, and post position before competition play.
